 Doetinchem Stage

It is time to rethink our urban wastewater treatment plants. The current generation of wastewater treatment systems focus on the destruction of carbon compounds and of nutrients, instead of on energy and nutrient recovery. Can we turn this around and go to energy positive wastewater treatment plants that harvest valuable materials? This is an ambitious topic which involves combining many innovative, as well as existing technologies, of both biological and physical-chemical nature. In this manner, a positive impact can be made on the footprint of wastewater treatment, to achieve a circular wastewater treatment plant. 
Your goal 
In this internship you will explore innovative treatments and reuse strategies for wastewaters and nutrients, to bring a more circular approach closer to reality. 
What will you be doing? We have listed it for you: - 
Conduct laboratory experiments to find optimal operational parameters for resource recovery technologies. - 
Evaluate approaches taken in literature. - 
Develop a process scheme for a circular wastewater treatment plant for which you investigate the feasibility. 
You will work on applied research in circular wastewater treatment, helping to bring innovative solutions to the market.

With modern rooms, vibrant public spaces, and easy access to the historic city centre, the hotel is the perfect base for both business travellers and leisure guests.

As a Front Office Host(ess), you are the face of the hotel, creating a warm and memorable first impression for every guest. You will manage arrivals and departures, handle guest requests, and ensure a smooth and efficient front office operation throughout your shift.
This role is key in delivering exceptional guest experiences while maintaining a welcoming and organised front desk environment.

The position is a full-time role (38 hours per week), ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic hospitality environment and enjoys connecting with people.

Responsibilities

• Welcome guests with warmth and professionalism, ensuring a positive first impression

• Manage check-ins, check-outs, and all front desk operations efficiently

• Handle guest requests, questions, and feedback in a proactive and service-minded way

• Communicate clearly with guests and team members to ensure seamless service

• Maintain accurate guest records and complete administrative tasks

• Provide local recommendations and enhance the guest experience

• Collaborate with housekeeping and other departments for smooth daily operations

Essential Requirements

• Fluent in Dutch (written and spoken) mandatory

• Good command of English

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Service-oriented mindset with attention to detail

• Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays

• Eligible to work in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in Front Office or a customer-facing role

• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)

• Knowledge of Utrecht or willingness to develop local expertise

• Additional language skills are an advantage

As a production employee, you will work in the Sorting department. Here, you will inspect and sort cylinders on the production line. Your tasks will include checking the valve, blowing out the cylinder, removing old labels, and verifying the cylinders. 
 Production employee - Waalwijk - LBO , MBO , - €14,99 - €17,31 per uur - Fulltime , 
 WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO DO? 
Operating the production line - regularly supplying the production line with empty packaging, packing products, and stacking finished goods on pallets. 
Maintaining cleanliness - keeping the work area clean and organized, with particular attention to the operated machine. 
Safe machine operation - operating machinery in accordance with safety procedures and workplace standards. 
Quality control and reporting issues - monitoring production processes and promptly reporting any errors or malfunctions to the direct supervisor. 
Product preparation and order assembly - cooperating with the team to efficiently prepare products for shipment and ensure proper pallet labeling. 
Teamwork - actively participating in the production process, including supporting other employees and departments when needed. 
Accuracy and diligence - performing tasks in line with required quality standards and ensuring timely completion of assigned duties. 
Compliance with safety standards - using personal protective equipment and maintaining a safe working environment for yourself and your colleagues.
